items.name: Finnish Championship 2026
items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. The schedule may be subject to change, so if you're leaving the venue during the day, make sure to return at least 30 minutes before your scheduled events. 50% of all final spots are reserved for competitors representing Finland. --- Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Aikataulu voi muuttua, joten jos poistut kisapaikalta päivän aikana, palaa vähintään 30 minuuttia ennen lajejasi. 50% finaalipaikoista on varattu Suomea edustaville kilpailijoille.

items.name: CubingUSA New England Championship 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEzOTUzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7227585daca31d145b4ac751d031b96994cce390/CNE2026_logo.PNG) We are pleased to announce the 2026 CubingUSA New England Championship! This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion.

items.name: Swiss Nationals 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg5ODcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6569dc4898b4089cdaecd37f75e4aa8447c8c94a/Senza%20titolo.png) ------------ [*IT*] Trattandosi del Campionato svizzero ufficiale di speedcubing, per le finali si applicano regole di qualificazione speciali, in modo che un numero sufficiente di concorrenti svizzeri vi acceda. I dettagli per ogni categoria si trovano [qui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwissNationals2026#82099-final-qualification-formats). [*DE*] Da dies die offizielle Speedcubing-Schweizermeisterschaft ist, gelten für die Finals spezielle Qualifikationsregeln, damit genügend Schweizer Teilnehmer ins Finale kommen. Die Details pro Disziplin findet ihr [hier](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwissNationals2026#82099-final-qualification-formats). [*FR*] Comme il s'agit du Championnat suisse officiel de speedcubing, des règles de qualification spéciales s'appliquent aux finales afin que suffisamment de compétiteurs suisses y accèdent. Les détails pour chaque épreuve se trouvent [ici](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwissNationals2026#82099-final-qualification-formats). [*EN*] As this is the official Swiss Speedcubing Championship, special qualification rules apply to the finals so that enough Swiss competitors reach the final. The details for each event can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwissNationals2026#82099-final-qualification-formats). --- [*IT*] Un grande ringraziamento a [GAN](https://gancube.com) per aver sponsorizzato questa competizione!
